The verdict

The right choice depends on the feeling.

✦ Most breathtaking

The Jefferson. Spectacular Christmas decorations, grand architecture, and an indoor pool. Choose it for a proper splurge.

♡ Most intimate & easy

O.Henry. Only about an hour away, elegant rooms, and the magical Nutcracker Tea. No indoor pool, but excellent low-stress charm.

❖ Best budget

Hotel Roanoke. A dramatic historic hotel and dozens of trees for much less. More winter-driving exposure near the Blue Ridge.

For the three of us

Less planning. More Christmas.

Early December 2026 · Two nights in one comfortable hotel · Plenty of time to enjoy it. All budgets are estimates for comparison only; events and rates are subject to availability. The Friday–Sunday dates are December 4–6, and Sunday–Tuesday dates are December 6–8.
